main_text.p: bus eloquentia pollentibus, quid com-muni saluti expediret, intelligebat, & pro salute expedienda, ac fortuna & statu suo tuendo prompte & fortiter contra hostes in discrimen se ferebat, ac pugnabat: atque adeò, ut erat, sub-limium ingeniorum more[illegible, ~1 letter], gloriæ & potentiæ avidissima, vitam potius per-dere, quàm libertatis ac imperii iactu-ram facere malebat. Ad hæc populus idem à Solone persuasus erat, & hoc penitus animis habebat infixum, libe-rarum civitatum, popularii imperio utentium, statum & vitam legibus con-fervari, & leges non esse leges, nisi iis rectè parerētur, ac parentibus honos & præmium, violatoribus pœna parata esset. Existimabat præterea, eodem do-ctore Solone, non magistratui leges, sed legibus magistratum subjici oportere, nec quicquam in civitate legibus[illegible, ~3 letters] debere esse firmius, non opes, non gratiam aut autoritatem, non factionem. Itaque cum maximè florebat respubli-ca, honores & præmia legibus congrua bene meritis prompte tribuebat, quibus non efferrentur eorum animi, aut in-folescerent, aut abuterentur in occasio-nem concupiscendæ & invadendæ ma-joris in republica potestatis, sed potius moderatis contenti esse discerent. Quod

page.notes: The right margin carries faint marks beside the lines "legibus" (illegible, about 3 letters), "debere" and "tiam" (small reference marks, not legible). The "à|Solone" in the text shows a vertical bar after "à", which may be a printed mark; read as "à Solone" with doubt. "popularii" is uncertain (could be "popularii" or "popularī"). The catchword at the foot right reads "Demo" with a possible hyphen, uncertain. Below it are faint ornaments or a signature-like mark ("s" or similar), not legible, not transcribed. Faint marks at the left edge are show-through or the neighbouring page and are excluded. The red edge at the right is the scan border and is excluded. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed.
